old: fn bounds(e:&BodyEntry2d)->(Vec2,Vec2){ let half=match &e.collider.shape { ColliderShape2d::Box{half_extents}=>Vec2::from(*half), ColliderShape2d::Circle{radius}=>Vec2::splat(*radius), ColliderShape2d::Capsule{half_height,radius}=>Vec2::new(*radius,*half_height+*radius), ColliderShape2d::Polygon{points}=>points.iter().fold(Vec2::ZERO,|m,p|m.max(Vec2::from(*p).abs())) }; let half=half*e.pose.scale.abs(); (e.pose.translation-half,e.pose.translation+half) }
